claims.claim_text: We have entered into an agreement with a prime contractor for the U.S. government to perform certain tasks and intend to seek to enter into other similar agreements with the U.S. government or prime contractors for the U.S government.
claims.subject: AST SpaceMobile
claims.object_value: unnamed prime contractor for U.S. government; unnamed DoD program; unnamed PE number
claims.source_quote: we have entered into an agreement with a prime contractor for the U.S. government to perform certain tasks and intend to seek to enter into other similar agreements with the U.S. government or prime contractors for the U.S government
claims.notes: Discriminative point: no PE number, no program name, no contract value, no prime contractor name disclosed. This vagueness itself is a J-Book discoverability gap.

claims.claim_text: Revenues for the three months ended June 30, 2024 were attributable to completion of performance obligations under an agreement with a prime contractor for a U.S. Government contract, which was entered into in the first quarter of 2024. Revenues = $900K in Q2 2024.
claims.subject: AST SpaceMobile
claims.object_value: $900K Q2 2024 from unnamed U.S. Government prime contract; 100% of 2024 reported revenue
claims.source_quote: Revenues $ 900 $ - $ 900 $ 100 % ... Revenues for the three months ended June 30, 2024 were attributable to completion of performance obligations under an agreement with a prime contractor for a U.S. Government contract, which was entered into in the first quarter of 2024.
claims.notes: 100% revenue concentration on an unnamed DoD-adjacent prime contract. Materiality is low in absolute dollar terms ($900K) but high in narrative terms (only revenue source). Cannot J-Book-verify because the program is not named.

claims.claim_text: We intend to leverage our patented technology, including large phased array and high power capability of our BB satellites, for a variety of applications in the government sector.
claims.subject: AST SpaceMobile
claims.object_value: unspecified DoD applications via phased-array BB satellites
claims.source_quote: We intend to leverage our patented technology, including large phased array and high power capability of our BB satellites, for a variety of applications in the government sector.
claims.notes: Forward-looking, narrative-load-bearing government-sector pipeline claim with NO named program, no PE. This is the kind of claim that lets a company invoke 'government use' without naming a J-Book line.
